You should try the following : check your connection, disable ad-blocker, clear your browser cache, try in private mode, try from another browser/computer/connection. 0 Jackpot: Set the Reel Jackpot: Set the Reel puts you in control of your own luck! This 'slotbuilder' challenges you to master the art of hand manipulation as you aim to make lines of three of the same symbol. But the twist is, you never shuffle your cards! Instead, through clever planning, tactical upgrades, and precise card swaps, you’ll manipulate your hand to strike massive payouts. Gain victory points by matching symbols, with bigger combos scoring bigger payouts. Upgrade cards to unlock rewards, and claim bonus tiles to boost your score or gain special abilities. Every choice matters. The game is played simultaneously and with each round, you’ll place three adjacent cards from your hand into your slot machine, forming a row. You'll repeat this twice more, building a grid and claiming points for completed matches. Then, pass your last card to the player on your left while receiving a card from the right, and placing it strategically to optimise your next move. Next, collect coins from one column of your slot machine, then reorder your columns in your hand while keeping each column’s cards in the sequence you just played them in. With your hand reset, you're ready for another round. Will you manipulate the cards, stack the odds, and hit the jackpot? Played cards are then assessed from left to right. For matching symbols (matching the leftmost card), gain the following: 1 symbol = 1 coin 2 symbols = Bonus token 3 symbols = Jackpot card On your turn you may also upgrade or buy cards with coins. Pass 10th Card Once you have taken 3 turns, you will pass your 10th card 'clockwise'. Gain Income Then, gain income from 1 column of cards. Reassemble Hand Finally, reassemble your hand by taking the columns into your hand one at a time. Game End The game ends when one player reaches 30VP, then any additional VP (from gold stars) is added. Coins Coins can be spent to upgrade cards (flip them to the other side) or buy new cards from the market. Upgrading Cards Cards can be upgraded by spending coins, which flips them to their other side. The reverse side of each card is shown on the left and right side of each card. On Board Game Arena, you can hover over the card to see the reverse side. Buying cards Cards in the market are limited - one of each type per player. For example, in a 2 player game, there are only 2 Bells, 2 Cherries, 2 Grapes, 2 Watermelons, and 2 '7' cards in the market. Bonus tokens Bonus tokens are gained when your leftmost and middle cards match, or when you gain the reward from the last Jackpot card of each type. [Rating: 1/10] Not a fan of how heavily this game leans into slot machines and jackpot-chasing. It feels more like gambling promotion than an original board game theme.

[Rating: 3/10] Engine builder where you play rows of cards with the aim to score sets, and building up your deck to score more of them using money.  Game feels emotionally very flat, and I view this as a thematic disconnect. A game about gambling at slots should have high highs and low lows, but the entire experience is very middling as it's an incremental engine builder at heart. You don't get a big rush of something paying out, you feel a cold satisfaction of your plan last turn coming together and setting you up nicely.
